summary: Fix correctly extends the encoding-to-content-type override map to cover 'br' and 'compress' encodings, matching how mimetypes.guess_type reports these suffixes and resolving the reported mis-detection as text/html. Change is minimal, consistent with the existing pattern (bzip2/gzip/xz), and introduces no regression risk.

issues.description: "application/x-brotli" and "application/x-compress" are unregistered/non-standard MIME types, but this mirrors the existing convention already used for bzip2 and xz in the same dict, so it's a non-issue stylistically.
